summary: Senior Manager / ALM Risk candidate with ~7 years across IRRBB analytics, balance-sheet risk oversight, and model governance. At Moody's Analytics, holds delegated sign-off authority on ALM and sensitivity outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios ($5–25bn per engagement). Hands-on with interest-rate risk analytics — including Economic Value of Equity and Net Interest Income sensitivities — under parallel and non-parallel rate shocks, cash-flow projection engines, and senior-stakeholder risk reporting. CFA charterholder; dual MSc (Financial Modelling, Engineering); Python and SQL fluent.
core_skills: Economic Value of Equity (EVE) & NII Sensitivity

sections.heading: IRRBB, ALM & Balance-Sheet Risk
bullets: Hold delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios ($5–25bn per engagement; ~$50bn+ cumulative), independently reviewing curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions prior to production release.

Oversee interest-rate risk and duration analysis under parallel and non-parallel rate shocks, aligned with IRRBB standards analogous to OSFI B-12 and Basel Committee frameworks; review Economic Value of Equity (EVE) and Net Interest Income (NII) sensitivity outputs at portfolio-level ALM aggregates.

Validate derivatives pricing outputs across rates, FX, and inflation, ensuring consistency of sensitivities and scenario impacts at portfolio-level ALM aggregates feeding downstream capital processes.

Review aggregation logic converting security-level exposures into portfolio-level risk metrics; escalate outputs lacking mathematical or economic defensibility to product owners and clients' Heads of Risk.

sections.heading: Cash Flow, Liquidity & Stress Analytics
bullets: Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash-flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios, delivering forward-looking balance-sheet visibility across ALM horizons.
Architected configurable time-bucketed liquidity gap analytics (T+1 through multi-year) enabling funding optimization, refinancing risk assessment, and asset-allocation decisions.
Embedded behavioral cash-flow assumptions, prepayment logic, and macro stress overlays aligned with regulatory liquidity expectations.

sections.heading: Reporting, Tooling & Stakeholder Engagement
bullets: Prepare analytical summaries for senior stakeholders covering interest-rate exposure, scenario impacts, and balance-sheet sensitivities, translating quantitative outputs into committee-ready narratives.
Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into scalable, auditable Python analytics pipelines with embedded logging and validation controls.
Mentor junior colleagues on ALM concepts, curve mechanics, and sensitivity interpretation; serve as escalation point for client-critical analytical issues.

Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms migrating to the PFaroe analytics platform; advised on asset, liability, and ALM configurations and validated model outputs post-deployment.

Served as technical liaison between client investment teams and product owners, scoping requirements into development requests; supported full migration of all assigned accounts from a legacy Calypso environment.

roles.title: Senior Consultant – IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 technology-transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients, aligning regulatory requirements with system implementation and financial-reporting frameworks.
Advised actuarial, IT, finance, and program-management functions on IFRS 17 / IFRS 9 adoption; contributed to governance documentation and regulatory-readiness processes.
Delivered ALM studies for Canadian and international pension funds and institutional investors, analyzing funding ratios, duration mismatch, and long-term balance-sheet risk exposures.
Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators assessing interest-rate risk and funding volatility under base-case and stressed environments.

Conducted liability-driven investment (LDI), cash-flow, liquidity, and hedging analysis across interest-rate, inflation, and currency risk; advised clients on Strategic and Tactical Asset Allocation trade-offs through stress testing and sensitivity analysis.

Led onboarding and the ALM study for the University Pension Plan (UPP) merger of three single-employer plans into a new jointly-sponsored plan — on a team of three developing and validating the model capturing funding-policy dynamics, duration, currency, inflation, and leverage overlay strategies.
Presented ALM study findings to investment committees at Canadian pension-fund clients, translating technical analysis into governance-level recommendations.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) – Western University, 2016
